user.title: Casa Mia app
user.description: Address of the Casa Mia app on the Supervisor network. Leave it empty to use the app found here ({found}); otherwise paste the Integration URL from the foot of the Casa Mia panel's home page (it is also in the app's log).

error.cannot_connect: The Casa Mia app did not answer at that address.
error.not_found: No Casa Mia app was found here: type its address (the Integration URL at the foot of the Casa Mia panel's home page, or in the app's log).

abort.already_configured: Casa Mia is already set up.

init.title: Casa Mia
init.description: The code the alarm panel asks for when arming and disarming (until one is set, the panel refuses both). The dashboard helpers are on the Casa Mia panel's Settings page (the cog by the house photo).

alarm_no_code.message: No alarm code is set. Set one in the Casa Mia integration's options.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Casa Mia

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Casa Mia integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works: new devices and entities do not exist yet. Restart Home Assistant to load it.

api_mismatch.title: Casa Mia app and integration disagree
api_mismatch.description: The app speaks API {app_api} but this integration expects API {expected_api}. Update the app and the integration together.

sensor_watch_refresh.name: Sensor Watch refresh state
sensor_watch_refresh.description: Fetch the watches from the app again and judge every one afresh, as at the start. For when a level looks stuck.

sensor_watch_list.name: Sensor Watch list
sensor_watch_list.description: Every watched entity at the chosen levels, worst first, then longest standing: its level, value, message and since when. Use it with a response variable, and loop over `sensors` in a template.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Which levels to list. Leave empty for everything that isn't nominal.

group.name: Group
group.description: Only the members of this group (as named on Casa Mia's Sensor Watch page), and its own worst level. Leave empty for every watched entity.

send_sms.name: Send text
send_sms.description: Send a text message through the FONA.
